Rung.description: Pearl's ladder. A query must declare which rung it asks about.
Rung.title: Rung

adjust_for.description: A user-chosen adjustment set. It is validated against the graph and refused if it is not a valid adjustment set.
adjust_for.title: Adjust For

cluster.description: Randomized designs only: the column identifying the unit of randomization (service, region, tenant) when outcomes are measured on finer units (requests, users). Standard errors are then cluster-robust; treatment must be constant within a cluster.
cluster.title: Cluster

estimand.description: ate: average effect over the population. att: average effect on the treated units (binary treatment only; needs overlap in one direction only).
estimand.title: Estimand

segment_by.description: Discrete, pre-treatment columns to estimate the effect within, declared before the answer is seen. The kernel does not search for subgroups: finding the subgroup with the largest effect is a different activity with different statistics, and reporting it as if it had been declared is how a team fools itself.
segment_by.title: Segment By

sequence.description: Randomized designs only: the column giving each unit's arrival order. When set, the effect is reported as an anytime-valid confidence sequence at every look, so the analysis may be read -- and stopped -- as often as wanted without inflating its error rate. Needs `expected_treated_share`, the known allocation probability.
sequence.title: Sequence

time.description: Panel designs only: the column holding the period, as an integer or an ordered value. Periods are the distinct values in sorted order.
time.title: Time

treatment_levels.description: (control, treated). Defaults to (0, 1) for a binary treatment; for a continuous treatment the effect is reported per unit unless levels are given.
treatment_levels.title: Treatment Levels

unit.description: Panel designs only: the column identifying the unit observed repeatedly.
unit.title: Unit
